args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding, but the
implementation imported and used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing
tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.

Replace ROUND_HALF_UP with ROUND_HALF_EVEN so values like
2.675 round to 2.68 and 2.665 round to 2.66.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but src/money.py imported and used ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

## Changes
- Import ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead of ROUND_HALF_UP.
- Quantize with ROUND_HALF_EVEN so ties round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66), per FIN-212.

## Testing
- CI run ci-0001 on branch fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding passed (tests/test_money.py).
